name: Bizcommunity

sources.title: Bizcommunity homepage - South African multi-industry business news site
Bizcommunity - Get a Biz listing page (Free R0 / Biz Listing R3500 p.a. / Biz Press Office)
Bizcommunity - Publish your news / Submit news page

requirements: Bizcommunity is a South Africa / Africa-focused multi-industry business news and company directory (19 industries)
Free listing tier (R0): entry-level - name-only search appearance, 1 search category, 3 services listed, 30-word profile, no email/logo/press releases shown in the free tier

Paid tiers: 'Biz Listing' R3,500/year (full-page showcase, bold name, 3 categories, 10 services, logo, images); 'Biz Press Office' / 'Platinum Press Office' (12-50 press releases, first in search) - priced on enquiry
Company news/press releases are a separate 'Publish your news on Biz' flow at /SubmitNews.aspx
preparation: Company name, 30-word profile, and up to 3 services (free-tier caps)
Pick the single most relevant industry category (free tier allows 1 search category)
Regional relevance: the directory is SA/Africa-centric - companies outside the region should confirm eligibility
For paid tiers: logo, images, company details; for Press Office: press release pipeline
workflow: From bizcommunity.com go to Companies -> 'Get a Biz listing' (/ListCompany.aspx; l/c params vary by industry/region)
Complete company details within free-tier limits (30-word profile, 3 services, 1 category)
Alternatively use 'Publish your news on Biz' (/SubmitNews.aspx) for a news submission rather than a company listing
For Biz Listing/Press Office tiers, use 'Setup'/'Enquire' or contact sales@bizcommunity.com / +27 21 404 1460
watchFor: The free tier is minimal - name-only in search, no logo, no press releases; value is the profile page itself
Page still shows an expired promo ('Order before 31 Dec 2021...') - pricing may be stale; confirm current prices with sales before paying
Don't confuse 'Get a Biz listing' (company directory) with 'Submit news' (editorial news submission) - different flows
Industry/region params (l=196&c=11) change the landing page context; navigate from the Companies menu to get the right one
countsAsLive: The company appears in the public company listings under its industry (e.g. /Companies/196/11.html) with at least a name-level entry
unknowns: Whether free listings require an account signup or verification
Whether non-African companies are accepted in the free tier
Whether the free listing includes any outbound link (free tier shows no profile page with link - only 'name' in search)
